en: Multiview Romanian postcard titled "caraș severin". It shows four scenes: a meadow and forest in the Cernei Mountains; a large modernist administrative building in Reșița; the spa resort of Băile Herculane with Hotel "Hercule"; and a panoramic view over Reșița's Bârzava meadow with apartment blocks. The reverse reads "CARTE POSTALA", has a Poșta Română printed 2 LEI stamp with the socialist emblem, address lines, and captions in Romanian/French listing the views. Photographer M. Bordea; code 3783/82; price 3,50 lei.
